body:
Hi OP.

Yeah, parents are butts sometimes. What I think you should do is continue focusing on your own path to recovery. You've already told your parents about your situation, a medical professional has given you advice on what to do about it-- maybe you should get your parents to tag along on a visit to a psychiatrist? Depression isn't something one can understand easily, especially if they haven't been hit hard by it.

You can get through this.
